text:
Stardew Valley Mod Manager is a free, open-source Windows desktop application that makes organizing, installing, and updating Stardew Valley mods simple. Manage your SMAPI mods, create separate mod profiles, and customize your farming experience through an intuitive graphical interface without using the command line.

 ⬇️ Installation

 Download the Windows application 

1. Open the repository's Releases page.
2. Download the latest release archive Stardew Valley Mod Manager 4.4.8.zip .
3. Extract the archive into a folder of your choice.
4. Keep Stardew Valley Mod Manager 4.4.8.exe and libvlc.dll together in that folder.
5. Double-click Stardew Valley Mod Manager 4.4.8.exe to launch the application.

 ✨ Features

- 🌱 Simple Mod Management — Browse, organize, enable, and disable your Stardew Valley mods from one convenient desktop interface.
- 🔧 SMAPI Integration — Work with the Stardew Modding API (SMAPI) to manage compatible mods and streamline your modded game setup.
- 🔄 Mod Update Checking — Check for available mod updates and make it easier to keep your installed modifications current.
- 📁 Custom Mod Profiles — Create independent mod collections for different playthroughs, farming strategies, and gameplay preferences.
- 🎮 Multiplayer Mod Sets — Maintain separate configurations for cooperative sessions and personal saves to avoid unnecessary mod conflicts.
- 🖥️ Visual Desktop Interface — Manage your entire mod library using a clean graphical interface instead of manually handling folders.
- 🌍 Cross-Platform Foundation — Built with Avalonia UI and modern .NET technologies for a flexible desktop experience.

 🖼️ Overview

 

The application brings essential Stardew Valley mod management tasks together in one place. Keep your mods organized, switch between configurations, and spend less time maintaining files and more time enjoying your farm.

 Why Use a Dedicated Stardew Valley Mod Manager?

Managing a large collection of Stardew Valley mods manually can become difficult. Different saves may require different modifications, multiplayer sessions can need specific configurations, and individual mods frequently receive updates.

A dedicated mod manager helps simplify these tasks:

 Task What You Get 
 --- --- 
 Mod organization A centralized view of installed mods 
 Mod compatibility SMAPI-based mod management 
 Different playthroughs Independent mod profiles 
 Mod maintenance Convenient update checking 
 Multiplayer preparation Separate mod configurations 
 Everyday management Accessible graphical controls 

 🚀 Usage

1. Open the application — Launch the Stardew Valley Mod Manager on your Windows desktop.
2. Configure your game — Connect the manager to your Stardew Valley installation and its modding environment.
3. Manage your mods — Review your installed SMAPI-compatible modifications and organize your collection.
4. Create profiles — Set up dedicated mod configurations for different saves, playstyles, or multiplayer sessions.
5. Check for updates — Review available updates to help keep your installed mods maintained.
6. Enjoy your farm — Launch Stardew Valley with the mod configuration you want to use.

 🎮 Built for Stardew Valley Players

Whether you're adding a handful of quality-of-life improvements or maintaining a substantial mod collection, keeping your game organized makes every playthrough easier.

This mod manager is useful for:

- New mod users who want an easier introduction to Stardew Valley modding.
- Experienced modders who maintain large collections of SMAPI-compatible mods.
- Multiplayer farmers who need different mod configurations for cooperative gameplay.
- Mod enthusiasts who regularly experiment with new modifications.
- Multiple-save players who prefer dedicated mod setups for different farms.

 🛠️ Technology

The application is built around established open-source desktop technologies.

 Technology Purpose 
 --- --- 
 C / .NET Application development 
 Avalonia UI Cross-platform graphical interface 
 SMAPI Stardew Valley modding integration 

 Compatibility

- Operating system: Windows desktop
- Game: Stardew Valley
- Modding framework: SMAPI
- Mod support: SMAPI-compatible Stardew Valley modifications
- Interface: Native-style graphical desktop application

Mod compatibility ultimately depends on the individual modification, its dependencies, and the installed SMAPI version.

 🔒 Security & Privacy

Your game configuration and mod collection should remain under your control.

- No telemetry: No built-in advertising or behavioral tracking.
- Open source: Application code can be inspected and independently audited.
- Local management: Mod organization is centered around your local game installation.
- Community reporting: Report bugs, unexpected behavior, or potential security issues through the repository's issue tracker.
- Mod awareness: Only install modifications from sources you trust, and review their requirements before enabling them.

For security-sensitive reports, avoid publishing exploit details or personal information in public issue discussions.

 🤝 Contributing

Contributions from the Stardew Valley and open-source communities are welcome.

Potential areas for improvement include:

- User interface enhancements.
- Better mod organization workflows.
- Profile management improvements.
- Compatibility and reliability fixes.
- Documentation and accessibility.
- Localization and translation improvements.

Before submitting a change, describe the problem it addresses and test the affected functionality.

 ❓ Frequently Asked Questions

 Is this a free Stardew Valley mod manager?

Yes. The application is open-source software distributed under the MIT License.

 Does it support SMAPI?

Yes. It is designed to work with SMAPI and compatible Stardew Valley modifications.

 Can I create different mod configurations?

Yes. Mod profiles allow you to maintain separate mod collections for different playthroughs and gameplay situations.
